info.title: Base44 Live Builder Updates
info.description: Live updates of the builder chat for the apps a white-label session may watch. The connection is Socket.IO, not a raw WebSocket: connect with `io(socket_url, { path: socket_path, transports: ["websocket"], auth: { session_token } })`, using the values your server received from `POST /api/service/socket-sessions`. Then send `join` for each app, and receive its snapshot followed by live events.

platform.description: Send the session token in the Socket.IO CONNECT `auth` as `session_token`. A refused connect is a `connect_error` with `message: "connection_denied"` and `data: { retryable }`: retry with backoff when `retryable`, otherwise ask your server for a new session.

platform.title: Platform socket
platform.description: One connection per session. Every event carries the `room` it belongs to, `/apps/{app_id}`; `room` is null for `session.ended`. Omitted keys in `data` are unchanged; explicit null clears.
